cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon's body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

cards.name: Heat Rotom
cards.description: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Gholdengo
cards.description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Naclstack
cards.description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.description: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
